System Model H2 (H2-1, H2-2)

Quantinuum · trapped ions · DEPLOYED (Jun 2023 (56 q from Jun 2024)) · 56 physical qubits · access: cloud (Nexus, Azure, AWS Braket)
architecture: יונים לכודים — QCCD (הובלה בין אזורים) · Open on the map

Register profile — the machine's variant of its architecture

qubit type: hyperfine clock qubit
gate mechanism: laser Molmer-Sorensen; arbitrary-angle RZZ + SU(4)
connectivity: all-to-all by transport around the racetrack
control: room-temperature electronics + free-space laser beams (gate beam pairs, 'sheet' cooling beams); ~4.8 control signals per qubit
control placement: room-temp + optics
readout: fluorescence with mid-circuit measurement and reset
codes: 4d_surface, stab_15_1_3, stab_8_3_2, steane
flags: code id missing in the register

שער לייזר מולמר–סורנסן / הסטת אור · primary ▣ §II (native U_ZZ(θ), crystal merge); App. A1.C + Fig. A2 (2Q RB, 4 gate zones) ✅
